title: Lodge Dormitory Key
summary: Opens the Traveller’s Chest in the first-floor dormitory of the Lodge.

fields.Acquisition: DC 15 Perception reveals the key on books behind the lobby counter. The chest can also be lockpicked at DC 10 and holds gold, alchemy ingredients and Lady Esther’s letter.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
